title: 9.2.0 | Sinister Grace
body:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11814497/c65068917acffd889c971346e4a05f74d55c9910.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]New Content[/b][/h2][h3][b]New Killer - The Krasue[/b][/h3][p][b]KILLER POWER: UNBODIED FLESH[/b][/p][list][*][p]The Krasue detaches from its body, emerging as a floating head with a trail of organs drifting behind it.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]SPECIAL ABILITY: CORPOREAL WEAVE[/b][/p][list][*][p]Press Ability Button 1[i] [/i]to shift between Body and Head Form.[/p][list][*][p]Body Form has a 32 meter[b] [/b]Terror Radius.[/p][/*][*][p]Head Form has a 40 meter Terror Radius. It is slightly faster but cannot break pallets and is not granted the Bloodlust status effect.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][b]KILLER EFFECT: LEECHED[/b][/p][list][*][p]Hitting a Survivor with[b] [/b]Intestinal Whip[b] [/b]and[b] [/b]Regurgitate[b] [/b]adds to their Leech Meter.[b] [/b]When the meter is filled, the Survivor is afflicted with Leeched I.[/p][list][*][p]Leeched I: The Leech Meter automatically fills over time, up to Leeched II.[/p][/*][*][p]Leeched II: The Survivor is afflicted with Broken. If healthy, they become injured.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][b]SPECIAL ABILITY: INTESTINAL WHIP[/b][/p][list][*][p]In Head Form, press the Attack Button to lash out with your internal organs.[/p][/*][*][p]Survivors afflicted with Leeched[b] [/b]can be damaged by Intestinal Whip.[/p][/*][*][p]Intestinal Whip partially fills a Survivor’s Leech Meter, up to Leech I.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]SPECIAL ABILITY: REGURGITATE[/b][/p][list][*][p]In Body Form, press and hold the Power Button to charge Regurgitate. When charged, tap the Attack Button to spew a Leeching Gland.[/p][/*][*][p]Leeching Gland completely fills a Survivor’s Leech Meter, up to Leech I.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]SPECIAL ABILITY: HEADLONG FLIGHT[/b][/p][list][*][p]In Head Form, press and hold the Power Button to speed through the air.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]SPECIAL ITEM: GLOWING FUNGUS[/b][/p][list][*][p]Survivors can eat Glowing Fungus[b] [/b]to decrease the Leech Meter over time. Being hit ends the effect.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]NEW KILLER PERKS:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Ravenous[/b][/p][list][*][p]Whenever you hook a Survivor for the first time, gain [b]1 token[/b], up to 4.[/p][/*][*][p]When you have [b]4 tokens[/b], all Survivors scream and gain Exposed for [b]40/50/60 seconds[/b].[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Wandering Eye[/b][/p][list][*][p]Whenever you start chasing a Survivor, reveal the auras of all other injured Survivors within [b]20/20/20 meters[/b] for [b]5/5/5 seconds[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]This perk has a [b]40/35/30-second[/b] cooldown.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Hex: Overture of Doom[/b][/p][list][*][p]Spawns a Hex Totem that curses the farthest generator and reveals its aura to you in yellow.[/p][/*][*][p]When a Survivor repairs the cursed generator for [b]5/5/5 seconds[/b], you gain [b]Undetectable [/b]and your Terror Radius is applied to the generator for [b]20/25/30 seconds[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]When the cursed generator is repaired, the next farthest generator is cursed.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3][b]New Survivor - Vee Boonyasak[/b][/h3][p][b]NEW SURVIVOR PERKS:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Road Life[/b][/p][list][*][p]While injured, not Broken and repairing a generator, gain [b]1/1/1 token[/b] for each regular great skill check success.[/p][/*][*][p]When you have [b]6/5/4 tokens[/b], spend all tokens and gain [b]100%/100%/100%[/b] healing speed until you stop healing.[/p][/*][*][p]Lose [b]1/1/1 token[/b] when you fail a regular skill check.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]ONE-TWO-THREE-FOUR![/b][/p][list][*][p]Press Ability button 2 while standing and idle to enter the "performance" interaction that lasts up to [b]15/15/15 seconds[/b] and empowers Survivors within [b]16/16/16 meters[/b]. You will get continuous skill checks during the performance. The effect lasts for [b]90/90/90 seconds[/b] if the performance is completed.[/p][list][*][p]Increases the odds of getting healing and repair skill checks by [b]20/20/20%[/b].[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]When the ability is cancelled or the performance completes, it goes on cooldown for [b]110/100/90 seconds[/b].[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Ghost Notes[/b][/p][list][*][p]While you have [b]Exhausted[/b], your scratch marks disappear [b]50/50/50% [/b]faster.[/p][/*][*][p]You recover [b]5/7.5/10% [/b]faster from [b]Exhausted[/b].[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h2][b]Features[/b][/h2][h3][b]Quality of Life Improvements[/b][/h3][list][*][p]The Match Details screen now displays the items and add-ons equipped (for Survivors), and the Killer power icon and add-ons equipped (for Killers). This is visible only for the player that has them equipped.[/p][list][*][p]As with perks, players can hover over these icons to display their tooltips.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Recovery while in the Dying State is now automatic and no longer requires a button to be held.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new scenario to the Abandon option: After recovering or being healed from the Dying State twice, the option to Abandon becomes available the next time you are downed.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Pallet Density Quality of Life Update[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Updated various Realms to adjust the quantity and distribution of pallets, reducing the presence of "dead zones".[/p][list][*][p]Affected Realms: The MacMillan Estate, Autohaven Wreckers, Coldwind Farm, Crotus Prenn Asylum, Haddonfield, Backwater Swamp, Red Forest, Yamaoka Estate, Ormond, The Decimated Borgo[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Updated all Realms to draw from the same pool of available maze tile layouts.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Menu Updates[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Updated the Tomes and Archives menus to offer an improved lore experience:[/p][list][*][p]Tomes are now displayed with the most recent Tome at the top of the list[/p][/*][*][p]Added VFX to distinguish the most recent Tome[/p][/*][*][p]New lore content is delivered regularly without players needing to complete Archives quests[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h2][b]Content Updates[/b][/h2][h3][b]Killer Rework - The Shape[/b][/h3][p][b]Summary[/b][/p][list][*][p]The Shape now has three modes: Stalker, Pursuer, and Evil Incarnate.[/p][/*][*][p]The Shape can swap between Stalker & Pursuer Modes without needing to Stalk.[/p][/*][*][p]The Shape must Stalk Survivors to unlock Evil Incarnate Mode.[/p][/*][*][p]While Evil Incarnate mode is active, The Shape has a new special attack: Slaughtering Strike.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated most add-ons.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Stalker Mode[/b] [i](Previously Evil Within I)[/i][/p][list][*][p]The Shape is [b]Undetectable[/b] and moves at [b]4.2m/s[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Hold the Power Button to Stalk nearby Survivors.[/p][/*][*][p]When the Stalk meter is full, automatically enter Pursuer Mode. Stalker Mode becomes unavailable.[/p][/*][*][p][i]Note: No longer decreases lunge range.[/i][/p][/*][/list][p][b]Pursuer Mode [/b][i](Previously Evil Within II)[/i][/p][list][*][p]The Shape has a [b]24m[/b] Terror Radius and moves at [b]4.6m/s[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Lunge range, breaking speed, vault speed, and stun recovery speed are increased by [b]20%[/b].[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Evil Incarnate Mode [/b][i](Previously Evil Within III)[/i][/p][list][*][p]When the Stalk meter is full, tap the Ability Button to activate Evil Incarnate Mode.[/p][/*][*][p]Evil Incarnate Mode lasts [b]40 seconds[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]The Shape has a [b]40m[/b] Terror Radius and moves at [b]4.6m/s[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Vault speed is increased by [b]20%[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Unlocks a new special attack: [b]Slaughtering Strike[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Unlocks the ability to kill Survivors who have reached the final hook stage. [i]This cannot be used on Survivors with Endurance.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Note: Survivors are no longer Exposed.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Note: No longer increases lunge range.[/i][/p][/*][/list][p][b]Special Attack: Slaughtering Strike[/b][/p][list][*][p]Hold the Power Button to charge a lunge, then press the Attack Button to begin the attack.[/p][/*][*][p]Holding the Power Button longer extends the lunge's duration up to a maximum of [b]1.5 seconds[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Slaughtering Strike has a base speed of [b]6.9m/s[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Hits with Slaughtering Strike instantly down healthy Survivors.[/p][/*][*][p]Slaughtering Strike can break pallets and breakable walls.[/p][/*][*][p]Slaughtering Strike has a [b]6 second[/b] cooldown.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Stalking[/b][/p][list][*][p]The Stalk meter now takes [b]5 points[/b] to fill ([i]was 3 for Tier 1, 6 for Tier 2[/i]).[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the movement speed multiplier when Stalking a Survivor to [b]60%[/b] ([i]was 20%[/i]).[/p][/*][*][p]Stalk rate is decreased by [b]25%[/b] while moving.[/p][/*][*][p]When the Stalk meter is not full, after [b]20 seconds[/b] of not Stalking, Stalk progress decays to [b]50%[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Decreased the maximum Stalking range to [b]32m[/b] ([i]was 40m[/i]).[/p][/*][*][p][i]Note: Survivors no longer have a limited amount of Stalk points.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Note: Stalk rate is no longer affected by distance.[/i][/p][/*][/list][p][b]The Shape's Add-Ons[/b][/p][list][*][p]Tacky Earrings:[/p][list][*][p]Increases movement speed while Stalking by [b]20% [/b][i](was 10%)[/i].[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Memorial Flower [i](Rework)[/i]:[/p][list][*][p]Increases movement speed in Stalker Mode to [b]4.4m/s[/b].[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Boyfriend's Memo [i](Rework)[/i]:[/p][list][*][p]Increases maximum Stalk range by [b]8 meters[/b].[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Blond Hair [i](Rework)[/i]:[/p][list][*][p]Scratch marks and pools of blood last [b]100%[/b] longer while in Stalker Mode.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Reflective Fragment [i](Rework)[/i]:[/p][list][*][p]Slaughtering Strike only deals a single health state of damage. Hitting a Survivor with Slaughtering Strike adds [b]20 seconds[/b] to Evil Incarnate's duration.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed rarity to Very Rare.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Jewelry [i](Rework)[/i]:[/p][list][*][p]Increases Stalk rate when Stalking stationary Survivors by [b]10%[/b].[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Hair Brush [i](Rework)[/i]:[/p][list][*][p]When Evil Incarnate is activated, the next pallet you break is destroyed [b]50%[/b] faster.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Glass Fragment [i](Rework)[/i]:[/p][list][*][p]Increases the movement speed of Slaughtering Strike by [b]5%[/b]. Decreases the charge speed of Slaughtering Strike by [b]10%[/b].[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Dead Rabbit:[/p][list][*][p]Decreases Terror Radius in Pursuer Mode by [b]25%[/b]. Increases Terror Radius in Evil Incarnate by [b]25%[/b].[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Mirror Shard [i](Rework)[/i]:[/p][list][*][p]Increases the base duration of Slaughtering Strike by [b]0.25 seconds[/b]. Decreases the charge speed of Slaughtering Strike by [b]25%[/b].[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Jewelry Box [i](Rework)[/i]:[/p][list][*][p]Decreases Stalk range by [b]16 meters[/b]. Increases Stalk rate by [b]30%[/b].[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]J. Myers Memorial [i](Rework)[/i]:[/p][list][*][p]While Evil Incarnate is active, your pickup and hook speeds are increased by [b]40%[/b].[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Hair Bow:[/p][list][*][p]Increases the duration of Evil Incarnate by [b]20 seconds[/b] ([i]was 30[/i]). Decreases Stalk rate by [b]20%[/b].[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Vanity Mirror [i](Rework)[/i]:[/p][list][*][p]When Evil Incarnate ends, you see the auras of all Survivors for [b]4 seconds[/b].[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Tombstone Piece [i](Rework)[/i]:[/p][list][*][p]When Evil Incarnate is activated, you become [b]Undetectable [/b]for [b]20 seconds[/b].[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Lock of Hair [i](Rework)[/i]:[/p][list][*][p]While Evil Incarnate is active, hold the Ability Button to end it prematurely and retain [b]50%[/b] of the remaining duration as Stalk progress.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Scratched Mirror:[/p][list][*][p]Changed rarity to Visceral.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Judith's Tombstone [i](Rework)[/i]:[/p][list][*][p]Hooking a Survivor during Evil Incarnate refreshes its duration. Limits the duration of Evil Incarnate to [b]40 seconds[/b].[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Fragrant Tuft of Hair [i](Rework)[/i]:[/p][list][*][p]Survivors become [b]Exposed[/b] while Evil Incarnate is active. Your lunge range is increased by [b]50%[/b] while in Evil Incarnate Mode. You can no longer use Slaughtering Strike.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed rarity to Uncommon.[/p][/*][*][p][i]Dev note: This add-on makes The Shape's power work similarly to how it used to. We've made it more common so those who prefer the original power can keep a steady supply.[/i][/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3][b]Killer Updates[/b][/h3][p][b]The Unknown[/b][/p][list][*][p]Increased [b]Weakened[/b] duration increase upon injuring a healthy Survivor with UVX projectile to [b]8 seconds [/b][i](was 6 seconds)[/i].[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced movement speed recovery time after teleporting to [b]1.3 seconds[/b] ([i]was 1.4 seconds[/i]).[/p][/*][*][p]Increased The Unknown's vertical camera axis to allow higher aim elevation with the UVX Projectile.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]The Unknown's Add-Ons[/b][/p][list][*][p]Rabbit's Foot:[/p][list][*][p]Afflicts the [b]Hemorrhage[/b] status effect to Survivors injured by UVX for [b]45 seconds[/b] ([i]was 30 seconds[/i]).[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Blurry Photo:[/p][list][*][p]After Teleporting, regain full movement speed [b]7%[/b] faster ([i]was 15%[/i]).[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Last Known Recording:[/p][list][*][p]Reduces the Hallucinations’ aura range visible to Survivors by [b]35%[/b] ([i]was 25%[/i]).[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Slashed Backpack:[/p][list][*][p]Destroying a Hallucination with UVX decreases the time until the next Hallucination spawns by [b]65%[/b] ([i]was 75%[/i]). The extra time should allow for more precise placement.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Vanishing Box:[/p][list][*][p]Increases Hallucination spawn time by [b]120%[/b] ([i]was 80%[/i]).[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Hypnotist’s Watch:
[/p][list][*][p]Inflicts the [b]Exhausted[/b] status effect for [b]15 seconds[/b] ([i]was 10 seconds[/i]).[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Serum Vial:[/p][list][*][p]Inflicts the [b]Exhausted[/b] status effect for [b]15 seconds[/b] ([i]was 10 seconds[/i]).[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][b]The Dark Lord[/b][/p][list][*][p]Vampire Form:[/p][list][*][p]Reduced the cooldown of Hellfire to [b]9.5 seconds[/b] [i](was 10 seconds)[/i].[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the number of Hellfire pillars to [b]8[/b] [i](was 7)[/i].[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced Hellfire charge movement speed to [b]3.68m/s[/b] [i](was 3.8m/s)[/i].[/p][/*][*][p]Increased movement speed recovery time after activating Hellfire to [b]2.35 seconds[/b] [i](was 2.25 seconds)[/i].[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Wolf Form:[/p][list][*][p]Increased Pounce Attack charge time to [b]0.9 seconds[/b] [i](was 0.85 seconds)[/i].[/p][/*][*][p]Increased Scent Orb spawn time to [b]6 seconds[/b] [i](was 5 seconds)[/i].[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Bat Form:[/p][list][*][p]Increased Bat Form flying movement friction to reduce sliding motion to [b]2.2[/b] [i](was 1.6)[/i].[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][b]The Dark Lord's Add-Ons[/b][/p][list][*][p]Ruby Circlet:[/p][list][*][p]Reduces the cooldown of Hellfire by [b]5%[/b] ([i]was 10%[/i]).[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Clock Tower Gear:[/p][list][*][p]Reduces the cooldown of Shapeshift by [b]5%[/b] ([i]was 10%[/i]).[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Traveler's Hat:[/p][list][*][p]Increases Shapeshift speed by [b]5%[/b] ([i]was 10%[/i]).[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Moonstone Necklace:[/p][list][*][p]Reduces the size of the Terror Radius in Vampire and Wolf Forms by [b]8 meters[/b] ([i]was 4 meters[/i]).[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Blood-Filled Goblet:[/p][list][*][p]Increases the duration of Scent Orbs by [b]60%[/b] ([i]was 50%[/i]).[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]White Wolf Medallion:[/p][list][*][p]Increases Killer Instinct duration by [b]1 second[/b] while in Wolf Form after Survivors complete rushed actions ([i]was 0.8 seconds[/i])[i].[/i][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Killer Doll:[/p][list][*][p]Increases the cooldown reduction of Pounce Attacks from Scent Orbs by [b]30% [/b]([i]was 50%[/i]).[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Force of Echo:[/p][list][*][p]Increases the spawn rate of Scent Orbs by [b]10%[/b] ([i]was 17%[/i]).[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Medusa's Hair:[/p][list][*][p]Survivors within [b]8 meters[/b] ([i]was 12 meters[/i]) of your teleport destination suffer from an 8% [b]Hindered[/b] status effect for [b]4 seconds[/b] ([i]was 3 seconds[/i]).[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Warg's Fang:[/p][list][*][p]Reveals the auras of all Survivors whose Scent Orbs you have collected for [b]5 seconds[/b] ([i]was 4 seconds[/i]).[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Lapis Lazuli:[/p][list][*][p]After teleporting to a window, it is blocked for [b]8 seconds[/b] ([i]was 15 seconds[/i]).[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Ring of Vlad:[/p][list][*][p]Hellfire pillar reduction downside [b]removed [/b]([i]was reduced by 1 pillar[/i]).[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][b]The Clown[/b][/p][list][*][p]Increased the time it takes for Afterpiece Antidote clouds to activate to [b]1.6 seconds[/b] ([i]was 1[/i]).[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the duration of the [b]Hindered[/b] effect after leaving an Afterpiece Tonic cloud to [b]1.6 seconds[/b] ([i]was 1[/i]).[/p][/*][/list][p][b]The Ghoul[/b][/p][list][*][p]When grabbing a Survivor on the other side of a vault with Kagune Leap, the Survivor is released at the start of the vault instead of the end.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]The Oni[/b][/p][list][*][p]Increased the number of Blood Orbs that spawn when hooking a Survivor to [b]5[/b] ([i]was 2[/i]).[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Survivor Perk Updates[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Clairvoyance:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Increased aura reading duration to [b]10/11/12 seconds[/b] ([i]was 8/9/10 seconds[/i])[i].[/i][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Friendly Competition:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Increased the bonus repair progress speed duration to [b]100/110/120[/b] [b]seconds[/b] ([i]was 45/60/75 seconds[/i])[i].[/i][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Hope:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Decreased the [b]Haste[/b] status effect gained when the Exit Gates are powered to [b]3/4/5%[/b] (was [i]5/6/7%[/i])[i].[/i][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]No Mither:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Increased the volume reduction for grunts of pain to [b]100%[/b] across all tiers ([i]was 25/50/75%[/i])[i].[/i][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Off the Record:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Removed the [b]Endurance[/b] status effect.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed the stipulation that it disables once Exit Gates are powered.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new effect: While active, you do not leave scratch marks while sprinting.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Leader:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Increased action speed bonus value to [b]20/25/30%[/b] ([i]was 15/20/25%[/i]).[/p][/*][*][p]Increased action speed bonus range to [b]10 meters[/b] ([i]was 8 meters[/i]).[/p][/*][*][p]Updated perk description to simplify linger effect.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Lucky Star:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Decreased cooldown to [b]35/30/25[/b] [b]seconds[/b] ([i]was 40/35/30 seconds[/i]).[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Pharmacy:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Unlocking chests is [b]75/100/125%[/b] faster [i](was 70/85/100%).[/i][/p][/*][*][p]The hearing distance for noises from unlocking chests is reduced by [b]12 meters[/b] [i](was 16 meters).[/i][/p][/*][*][p]Guarantees an Emergency Med-Kit upon completing the interaction.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Plot Twist:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added a new effect: Increases recovery speed by [b]25%[/b] when used.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Poised:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Increased Killer aura reveal duration when repairing a generator for the first time to [b]8 seconds[/b] ([i]was 6 seconds[/i]).[/p][/*][*][p]Increased time where you leave no scratch marks after a generator is completed to [b]20/25/30 seconds[/b] ([i]was 10/12/14 seconds[/i]).[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Quick Gambit:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Decreased the cooldown when losing a health state to [b]40 seconds[/b] ([i]was 60 seconds[/i]).[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Tenacity:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added a new effect: Prevents your aura from being read while in the Dying State.[/p][/*][*][p]Decreased crawling speed bonus to [b]15/20/25%[/b] ([i]was 30/40/50%[/i]).[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Vigil:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Survivors can now only benefit from one Vigil perk's effect at a time ([i]previously stacked with other versions of itself[/i]).[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3][b]Killer Perk Updates[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]All-Shaking Thunder:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Increased lunge attack distance increase duration to
